hooks.command: c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); echo "$c" | grep -qE '(^|[;&|(])[[:space:]]*git([[:space:]]+)commit' || exit 0; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || exit 0; if ! node scripts/quality/assert_tests_untouched.mjs; then echo 'commit blocked: tests-untouched guard failed (test region touched)' >&2; exit 2; fi
